name: ModelVariant838_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant838_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a comet forms on a model part as a spinning fan with fading comet trails, then flies to the opposing side, shedding smoke puffs and sparks; on arrival it bursts into a glow with flying debris, light streaks and expanding sparks, flashes the screen and sends a textured shock ring out from the launch point while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the trails, puffs, sparks, debris and streaks and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the delay, 4 on each frame after the comet arrives until the end time, 1 once after the end time as the screen flash starts, 2 once the burst colour has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-855 and 952 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
